units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:14">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>נשוק כיפי ד־׳ וכ׳</he> the shores of the Tigris touched each other (the water forming a level with the banks).
<cite ref="Taanit 24b:9">Taan. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>שפוך מרזבי דמחוזא לד׳</he> (not <he>דציפורי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the gutters of Maḥuza emptied themselves into the Tigris.
